steps_binary-calculator_1Desc: Type binary numbers (0s and 1s) or decimal numbers in the input fields. The calculator displays both representations for clarity.
steps_binary-calculator_2Desc: Choose an operation — addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Results are shown in both binary and decimal formats simultaneously.
steps_binary-calculator_3Desc: Click Copy to grab the result in binary or decimal format. Ideal for computer architecture coursework, bit-level debugging, or learning binary arithmetic.
